name: deltadot-desktop
description: DeltaDot Desktop — Git workspace sync checker

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && NODE_ENV=development electron dist-electron/electron/main.js --no-sandbox"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
